<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Veiled Master (Vidileth)](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2813)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The powerful vidileths are the insidious, veiled masters of the alghollthus. These manipulators of mind and body alike lead sweeping alghollthu plots, using their ability to change form to walk among and deceive humans and other sapient species.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Aberration](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)): DC 37

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 35

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 32
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Vidileth.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 14">[Vidileth](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2813)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Aberration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=523" />
<trait label="Aquatic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=533" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 12

**Perception** +25; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Alghollthu](/Languages.aspx?ID=24), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Sakvroth](/Languages.aspx?ID=118), [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113); [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728)

**Skills**
[Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +27, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +24, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +28, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +26, [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +29, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +29, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +27, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +24

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +6

**Dex** +6

**Con** +8

**Int** +7

**Wis** +5

**Cha** +6
</row>

**Numbing Lights** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) 30 feet. The vidileth exudes [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408). Creatures within the light must attempt a DC 34 Will save each round, becoming [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) on a failure (or increase their stupefied value from numbing lights by 1, to a maximum of 4).

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 34 

**Fort** +26 

**Ref** +22 

**Will** +24 

+2 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644)
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 270

</row>

**Immunities**
[controlled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=64), [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)

**Resistances**
[cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555) 20

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 10 feet, swim 80 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
fangs +28 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [versatile S](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 3d8+12 piercing plus consume memories

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +28 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 3d10+12 slashing plus shape flesh

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
tentacle +28 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=56), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 7d6 electricity plus thoughtlance

**Occult Innate Spells** DC 37
- **3rd**
[Hypnotize](/Spells.aspx?ID=1564) (at will), [Levitate](/Spells.aspx?ID=170) (at will), [Mind Reading](/Spells.aspx?ID=194) (at will), [Water Breathing](/Spells.aspx?ID=370) (at will)
- **5th**
[Illusory Object](/Spells.aspx?ID=160) (at will), [Mirage](/Spells.aspx?ID=1604) (at will), [Sending](/Spells.aspx?ID=272) (at will), [Translocate](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724) (×3)
- **6th**
[Dominate](/Spells.aspx?ID=87) (×3)
- **7th**
[Illusory Disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=159) (at will)
- **8th**
[Illusory Scene](/Spells.aspx?ID=161) (at will), [Suggestion](/Spells.aspx?ID=315) (×3)
- **9th**
[Project Image](/Spells.aspx?ID=237) (at will)
- **Constant (5th)**
[Truespeech](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728)

**Rituals** DC 37

- **3rd**
[Geas](/Rituals.aspx?ID=12) (5th)

**[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=55)** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** A vidileth takes on the appearance of a [humanoid](/Traits.aspx?ID=628) of Large, Medium, or Small size or resumes its true form. While in humanoid form, the vidileth's Speed is 30 feet, and it loses its numbing lights aura and swim Speed. If the humanoid form assumed lacks the [aquatic](/Traits.aspx?ID=533) trait, the vidileth loses its own aquatic trait as well. In humanoid form, the vidileth can use weapons or make Strikes that work like its tentacle attack but use the reach of its current form. If the form has fangs or claws, the vidileth can also make such Strikes.

**Consume Memories**  ([Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) When the vidileth hits with a fangs Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 34 Will save or take 3d6 mental damage. The vidileth gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt and learns some of the creature's memories (subject to the GM's discretion).

**Delayed Suggestion**  ([Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) When a vidileth successfully casts [_dominate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1501) on a creature, a [_suggestion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1693) spell triggers when the _dominate_ spell ends. This _suggestion_ usually causes the target to return to the vidileth, so the creature can cast _dominate_ again, but a vidileth can set the _suggestion_ to different orders if it wishes.

**Shape Flesh** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), [Manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Requirements** The vidileth's last action was a success with a claw Strike; **Effect** The vidileth sloppily modifies the target's flesh. They must succeed at a DC 34 Fortitude save or permanently receive the veiled master's choice of [clumsy 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [enfeebled 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), or a –10 status penalty to Speed.

**Tentacle Flurry** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The vidileth makes a tentacle Strike against each creature within its reach. Make only one attack roll, and roll damage once for all targets.

**Thoughtlance**  ([Curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) A creature touched by the vidileth's tentacles must attempt a DC 34 Will save, becoming [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) on a failure or slowed 2 on a critical failure. Each time the affected creature ends its turn, its slowed value decreases by 1.

</column>
